subject.title: fix: preserve Feishu post line breaks

question: Should maintainers require live Feishu/Lark proof on this branch before choosing it over the proof-positive but conflicting sibling fix?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a mechanical code repair; it is proof sufficiency plus acceptance of the near-limit formatting fallback and canonical branch choice.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for ordinary prose, fenced code, raw tables, and the near-limit fallback before this branch can merge.

options.title: Adopt the proof-positive sibling after refresh
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 as the canonical fix only after its conflicts are resolved and maintainers accept its broader fanout behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded fallback tradeoff
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept that near-limit messages keep original single newlines, but that message-delivery tradeoff should be explicit before merge.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for ordinary prose, fenced code, raw tables, and the near-limit fallback before this branch can merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata identifies m1heng as the community maintainer, making this the strongest owner signal for Feishu-specific rendering behavior.
